title: How to Build a Podcast Website: Episode Player, Show Notes, and Listener Community
summary: Build a custom podcast website with AI — episode player, show notes, newsletter signup, and membership tier. No Podpage fees. Database and hosting included.
body_markdown: Podpage has strong SEO defaults — automatic schema markup, sitemap generation, and SEO-optimized episode URLs. A custom Blink site gives you complete control over every on-page element: episode title tags, meta descriptions, structured data, and internal linking between related episodes. The real SEO advantage is depth: show notes stored in a real database can be structured as standalone long-form content pages that rank independently. Detailed, searchable show notes on 200 episodes is a content SEO asset that a template-constrained site can't replicate at the same depth.
